title: Service deployment workflow step result
description: One step's outcome, recorded by platform/playbooks/tasks/emit-step-result.yml through set_stats and read from the task output's CUSTOM STATS block. Design: plan 15, Contracts.

workflow_id.description: Set by the orchestrator; empty for a human-launched run.

check_mode.description: True when the run was a dry run (--check).

evidence.description: The registry's evidence keys for this step.
